changelog: Series get a theme song on their page, including shows that aren't in your library yet. The engine fetches each theme ahead of time for every series on a user's home screen, from ThemerrDB or a YouTube search for the show's theme or title track. Replaces 1.4.9.0, which also took themes from Plex's theme server. Requires Jellyfin 12.1 or later. This is a beta release.
